links.comparator_used: Original ASRS Retina Health Fact Sheets (unsimplified)
links.outcome: Readability (ARLCalc consensus grade level) of retina patient education text
links.effect: ASRS Enhanced (GPT-4 rewritten to sixth-grade level) 9.37 (± 1.09) vs original ASRS Fact Sheet 12.85 (± 0.89); significant difference across the 4 groups (P < .001)
links.tradeoff: Rewritten text still did not reach the sixth-grade target. The authors state that specialty-authored material remains the gold standard for accurate medical information.
links.quote: The ARLCalc scores for the ASRS Fact Sheet, GPT-4 Response, GPT-4 Enhanced, and ASRS Enhanced responses were 12.85 (± 0.89), 12.37 (± 0.97), 8.66 (± 0.87), and 9.37 (± 1.09), respectively.

links.comparator_used: Default GPT-4 generated patient education text without a reading-level instruction
links.outcome: Readability (ARLCalc consensus grade level) of GPT-4 generated patient education text
links.effect: GPT-4 Enhanced (prompted for sixth-grade level) 8.66 (± 0.87) vs GPT-4 Response (default) 12.37 (± 0.97); significant difference across the 4 groups (P < .001)
links.tradeoff: Output still exceeded the requested sixth-grade level. Accuracy of the simplified text was not reported as assessed.
links.quote: The ARLCalc scores for the ASRS Fact Sheet, GPT-4 Response, GPT-4 Enhanced, and ASRS Enhanced responses were 12.85 (± 0.89), 12.37 (± 0.97), 8.66 (± 0.87), and 9.37 (± 1.09), respectively.
